title: Ambroxol mitigates cyclophosphamide-induced liver injury by suppressing TLR-4/NF-kappaB signaling and oxidative stress and upregulating cytoglobin, TXNRD1 and HMGB1.
authors: Alruhaimi, Reem S; Hassanein, Emad H M; Alnasser, Sulaiman M; Ahmeda, Ahmad F; Althagafy, Hanan S; Abd El-Ghafar, Omnia A M; Mahmoud, Ayman M
one_liner_zh: 该文研究氨溴索对环磷酰胺肝损伤的保护作用，涉及分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Cyclophosphamide (CP) is a potent chemotherapeutic and immunosuppressant agent, but its hepatotoxicity remains a significant concern. Ambroxol (ABX) is a mucolytic agent with emerging beneficial effects against oxidative stress and inflammation. AIM: To investigate the hepatoprotective effects of ABX against CP-induced liver injury, focusing on oxidative stress, inflammation, and the possible role of cytoglobin, thioredoxin reductase 1 (TXNRD1) and high-mobility group box 1 (HMGB1). METHODS: ABX (20 mg/kg) was orally administered for 7 days, and the rats received a single injection of CP (100 mg/kg) on day 5. Blood and liver samples were collected for analyses, and the affinity of ABX towards cytoglobin, TXNRD1, and HMGB1 was evaluated using molecular docking. RESULTS: CP administration significantly elevated alanine aminotransferase, aspartate aminotransferase, and alkaline phosphatase, reduced albumin, and caused multiple histopathological alterations in the liver. ABX effectively restored liver function biomarkers and attenuated histopathological alterations. CP-induced oxidative stress was evidenced by increased malondialdehyde and decreased glutathione and antioxidant enzyme activities, all of which were ameliorated by ABX. CP upregulated toll-like receptor 4 (TLR-4), nuclear factor-kappaB (NF-kappaB) p65 and pro-inflammatory cytokines, while downregulating cytoglobin, TXNRD1 and HMGB1. ABX suppressed TLR-4/NF-kappaB signaling and pro-inflammatory cytokines, and upregulated cytoglobin, TXNRD1 and HMGB1. In silico molecular docking revealed the affinity of ABX to bind with cytoglobin, TXNRD1, and HMGB1. CONCLUSION: ABX protects against CP hepatotoxicity by mitigating oxidative stress, suppressing TLR-4/NF-kappaB signaling, and upregulating cytoglobin, TXNRD1 and HMGB1. ABX showed binding affinity towards cytoglobin, TXNRD1 and HMGB1. These findings suggest that ABX has therapeutic potential in alleviating hepatotoxicity associated with CP treatment.
abstract_zh: 背景：环磷酰胺（CP）是一种强效化疗和免疫抑制剂，但其肝毒性仍是一个重要问题。氨溴索（ABX）是一种黏液溶解剂，新近显示出对抗氧化应激和炎症的有益作用。目的：研究ABX对CP诱导肝损伤的保护作用，重点关注氧化应激、炎症以及细胞珠蛋白、硫氧还蛋白还原酶1（TXNRD1）和高迁移率族蛋白B1（HMGB1）的可能作用。方法：ABX（20 mg/kg）口服给药7天，大鼠在第5天接受单次CP注射（100 mg/kg）。收集血液和肝脏样本进行分析，并使用分子对接 (molecular docking) 评估ABX与细胞珠蛋白、TXNRD1和HMGB1的亲和力。结果：CP给药显著升高丙氨酸氨基转移酶、天冬氨酸氨基转移酶和碱性磷酸酶，降低白蛋白，并导致肝脏多种组织病理学改变。ABX有效恢复肝功能生物标志物并减轻组织病理学改变。CP诱导的氧化应激通过丙二醛增加和谷胱甘肽及抗氧化酶活性降低得以证实，所有这些均被ABX改善。CP上调Toll样受体4（TLR-4）、核因子-κB（NF-κB）p65和促炎细胞因子，同时下调细胞珠蛋白、TXNRD1和HMGB1。ABX抑制TLR-4/NF-κB信号通路和促炎细胞因子，并上调细胞珠蛋白、TXNRD1和HMGB1。计算机模拟分子对接显示ABX具有与细胞珠蛋白、TXNRD1和HMGB1结合的亲和力。结论：ABX通过减轻氧化应激、抑制TLR-4/NF-κB信号通路以及上调细胞珠蛋白、TXNRD1和HMGB1来保护免受CP肝毒性。ABX对细胞珠蛋白、TXNRD1和HMGB1显示出结合亲和力。这些发现表明ABX在缓解CP治疗相关肝毒性方面具有治疗潜力。
